extraction.name: PIQA: Reasoning about Physical Commonsense in Natural Language
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for physical commonsense reasoning
extraction.creator: Yonatan Bisk, Rowan Zellers, Ronan Le Bras, Jianfeng Gao, Yejin Choi
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is collected from instructables.com, a crowdsourced collection of instructions for doing everyday tasks. Annotators were asked to provide semantic perturbations or alternative approaches which are otherwise syntactically and topically similar to ensure physical knowledge is targeted.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection is based on how-to instructions from instructables.com.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset is cleaned of basic artifacts using the AFLite algorithm, which performs a systematic data bias reduction.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset is preprocessed to remove stylistic artifacts and trivial examples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were asked to provide a physical goal and two possible solutions, one correct and one incorrect. The incorrect solution is often a subtle perturbation of the correct solution.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotations are analyzed to ensure physical knowledge is targeted and to remove any biases.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has the potential to improve the physical commonsense understanding of AI systems, which can have a significant social impact in areas such as robotics and natural language processing.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is designed to be adversarial to BERT, which means it is biased towards testing the physical commonsense understanding of language models.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of its size and scope, and may not be representative of all physical commonsense scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training and testing natural language understanding models, particularly those that require physical commonsense knowledge.
